Unstable ranking (tau=0.033) + different best model per window; DBA optimizes per-horizon weights to handle this, a different kind from static weighted/mean/trimmed.

Simple mean over all 19 models as a robust baseline; tests whether weighted strategies (leader a7) truly outperform a flat average given unstable ranking (tau=0.033) and only 3 validation windows.
